project.description_en: At the end of the theme, the child helps prepare a class festival: makes a card with a word written on it, says their birthday month in French, mixes colours for the decorations, dances and thanks the guests.

activities.goal_en: Recite a mathematical rhyme counting in twos.
activities.prompt_en: Count the balloons with the rhyme: two, four, six…
steps_en: Say the rhyme with gestures, showing two balloons each time.
Repeat it line by line.
Say it together.
Count to 20 in twos with real balloons or circles.
source_refs: Nursery Two, table 34 (Poetry and Rhymes: Rhymes), p. 61; theme 4: Festivities/Celebrations (table 13, p. 37)

editorial.notes: Activity written for Klassia from the Nursery Two contents of the English-subsystem nursery curriculum; original texts. To be reviewed by a Nursery Two teacher of the English subsystem.

activities.story_en:
Two red balloons, four, six, eight,
Ten at the door, we cannot wait!
Twelve, fourteen, sixteen in the air,
Eighteen, twenty, balloons everywhere!

activities.goal_en: Read pictures of festivals and share information.
activities.prompt_en: Look at these pictures. Which festival is it? What do people do?
steps_en: Show pictures: a birthday, a wedding, a harvest festival, the national day, a religious feast.
Name each one together.
Ask what people do, wear and eat.
Make a festival album.
observe_en: Shares a festival of their family.
source_refs: Nursery Two, table 36 (Reading: Picture reading), p. 63; theme 4: Festivities/Celebrations (table 13, p. 37)

editorial.notes: Activity written for Klassia from the Nursery Two contents of the English-subsystem nursery curriculum; original texts. To be reviewed by a Nursery Two teacher of the English subsystem.

activities.goal_en: Write a short word with upper case and lowercase letters on a card.
activities.prompt_en: Let us write “Happy day” on the card for our friend.
steps_en: Show the model with a capital H.
Trace the letters with a finger.
Copy the words on the card.
Decorate the card.
observe_en: Leaves a space between the words.
source_refs: Nursery Two, table 37 (Writing: Letters and numbers), p. 64; theme 4: Festivities/Celebrations (table 13, p. 37)

editorial.notes: Activity written for Klassia from the Nursery Two contents of the English-subsystem nursery curriculum; original texts. To be reviewed by a Nursery Two teacher of the English subsystem.

activities.goal_en: Say the months of the year in French with help and one’s birthday month.
activities.prompt_en: In French: janvier, février, mars, avril, mai, juin, juillet, août, septembre, octobre, novembre, décembre.
steps_en: Say the months slowly, clapping once for each.
The child repeats.
Find the birthday month on a calendar.
Say: “Mon anniversaire, c’est en …”.
observe_en: Finds their month on the calendar.
source_refs: Nursery Two, table 38 (French: Les mois de l’année), p. 65; theme 4: Festivities/Celebrations (table 13, p. 37)

editorial.notes: Activity written for Klassia from the Nursery Two contents of the English-subsystem nursery curriculum; original texts. To be reviewed by a Nursery Two teacher of the English subsystem.

activities.goal_en: Take away and say how many are left, within 20.
activities.prompt_en: We have 15 balloons. 5 fly away. How many are left?
steps_en: Put 15 circles or sticks on the table.
Take 5 away.
Count what is left.
Try other numbers.
source_refs: Nursery Two, table 39 (Mathematics: Mathematical operations), p. 66–67; theme 4: Festivities/Celebrations (table 13, p. 37)

editorial.notes: Activity written for Klassia from the Nursery Two contents of the English-subsystem nursery curriculum; original texts. To be reviewed by a Nursery Two teacher of the English subsystem.

activities.goal_en: Read o’clock times and name the parts of the day.
activities.prompt_en: Look at the clock: the short hand is on 3, the long hand is on 12. It is 3 o’clock.
steps_en: Show a clock face.
Place the hands for 3 o’clock and read it.
Talk about morning, afternoon, evening and night.
Set the clock for other times of the day.
observe_en: Names the parts of the day.
source_refs: Nursery Two, table 39 (Mathematics: Time), p. 66–67; theme 4: Festivities/Celebrations (table 13, p. 37)

editorial.notes: Activity written for Klassia from the Nursery Two contents of the English-subsystem nursery curriculum; original texts. To be reviewed by a Nursery Two teacher of the English subsystem.

interactive.prompt_en: The short hand is on 3 and the long hand is on 12. What time is it? (Write the hour)
interactive.explanation_en: The short hand shows the hour: it is 3 o’clock.

activities.goal_en: Mix colours to make new ones.
activities.prompt_en: Red and yellow make… orange! Blue and yellow make… green! Let us try.
steps_en: Put a drop of red and a drop of yellow paint in a cup.
Mix and see the new colour.
Try blue and yellow, red and blue.
Paint decorations with the new colours.
source_refs: Nursery Two, table 42 (Science and Technology: Experiments), p. 73–75; theme 4: Festivities/Celebrations (table 13, p. 37)

editorial.notes: Activity written for Klassia from the Nursery Two contents of the English-subsystem nursery curriculum; original texts. To be reviewed by a Nursery Two teacher of the English subsystem.

activities.title_en: The national day and our leaders
activities.goal_en: Recognise the flag, know that the national day is celebrated and name some leaders.
activities.prompt_en: On 20 May, Cameroon celebrates its national day: people march with the flag. The President leads the country.
steps_en: Show the flag and name its colours.
Show a picture of the national day parade.
Name some leaders: the President, the Governor, the Mayor, the chief or Fon.
March in class with a paper flag.
observe_en: Says that we celebrate the national day.
materials_en: a small flag or a picture
source_refs: Nursery Two, table 44 (Citizenship: National emblems and officials), p. 77; theme 4: Festivities/Celebrations (table 13, p. 37)

editorial.notes: Activity written for Klassia from the Nursery Two contents of the English-subsystem nursery curriculum; original texts. To be reviewed by a Nursery Two teacher of the English subsystem.

activities.goal_en: Share and show solidarity so that everyone takes part.
activities.prompt_en: At our party, everybody gets a part of the cake, even the friend who forgot to bring something.
steps_en: Tell a short story: one child has nothing to share.
Ask: what can we do?
Share food or decorations so that everyone has some.
Say thank you to each other.
source_refs: Nursery Two, table 45 (Character Education: Good behaviour), p. 78; theme 4: Festivities/Celebrations (table 13, p. 37)

editorial.notes: Activity written for Klassia from the Nursery Two contents of the English-subsystem nursery curriculum; original texts. To be reviewed by a Nursery Two teacher of the English subsystem.

activities.title_en: Party plate: what and how much
activities.goal_en: Choose healthy food and drinks at a party and eat only what is needed.
activities.prompt_en: At a party we choose fruit and water, we eat a little cake, and we stop when we are full.
steps_en: Show pictures of party food and drinks.
Make a healthy plate together.
Talk about stopping when full.
Wash hands before eating.
observe_en: Takes a small portion of sweet food.
source_refs: Nursery Two, table 48 (Health Education and Nutrition: Good health habits), p. 81; theme 4: Festivities/Celebrations (table 13, p. 37)

editorial.notes: Activity written for Klassia from the Nursery Two contents of the English-subsystem nursery curriculum; original texts. To be reviewed by a Nursery Two teacher of the English subsystem.

activities.goal_en: Discover music from other parts of Africa and dance with respect.
activities.prompt_en: Listen to this music from another African country. Let us move to it!
steps_en: Play a piece of music from another African region (for example a Lingala or a Swahili song).
Say where it comes from on a map of Africa.
Find the beat by clapping.
Dance freely, then copy a step.
observe_en: Says that music comes from many countries.
source_refs: Nursery Two, table 49 (Music and Dance: Non-Cameroonian music), p. 82; theme 4: Festivities/Celebrations (table 13, p. 37)

editorial.notes: Activity written for Klassia from the Nursery Two contents of the English-subsystem nursery curriculum; original texts. To be reviewed by a Nursery Two teacher of the English subsystem.

activities.goal_en: Move with rhythm and balance on tiptoe, like in ballet.
activities.prompt_en: Stand on your toes, arms up like a crown, and turn slowly to the music.
steps_en: Stand on tiptoe for five seconds.
Walk on tiptoe to the music.
Turn slowly with arms up.
Stop when the music stops.
source_refs: Nursery Two, table 53 (Physical Education and Sports: Gymnastics), p. 86; theme 4: Festivities/Celebrations (table 13, p. 37)

editorial.notes: Activity written for Klassia from the Nursery Two contents of the English-subsystem nursery curriculum; original texts. To be reviewed by a Nursery Two teacher of the English subsystem.

scale.description: Succeeds mostly with a model or help.
Sometimes succeeds alone, sometimes with a reminder.
Succeeds on their own in a familiar situation.

indicators: Writes a short word on a card.
Says the months in French with help.
Mixes two colours to make a third.
Recognises the flag and says why we celebrate the national day.

sources: Cameroon Nursery School Curriculum, English Subsystem, MINEDUB, 2018: table 13 (integrated learning themes), p. 37; Nursery Two tables, cited and not reproduced.
